Rosiglitazone attenuates transplant arteriosclerosis after allogeneic aorta transplantation in rats. Transplant arteriosclerosis is a leading cause of chronic transplant dysfunction and is characterized by occlusive neointima formation in intragraft arteries. Development of transplant arteriosclerosis is refractory to conventional immunosuppressive drugs and adequate therapy is not available.
